about: The mutant ledger of internal/sketch/std: edits of the std sources (the .ergo declarations and the Go that reads them) that some test, law or example must kill. Run it with go run ./scripts/mutants ./internal/sketch/std; docs/tooling.md, "Mutant ledger", says when a change must run it and how to add a mutant. Seeded by ESC1 (wf10, lang audit B F1).

mutants.name: esc1-timeout-nonescaping
mutants.from: f escaping func() A fails E needs R
mutants.to: f func() A fails E needs R
mutants.rule: A joined child task is not the caller's task: a timeout callback cannot borrow a caller-owned Set.

mutants.name: esc1-transform-nonescaping
mutants.rule: types.md, Function values 2: a callback that runs on other tasks at the same time is escaping, so the capture rule refuses a write to the caller's let mut (lang audit B F1, probe race).

mutants.name: esc1-feed-nonescaping
mutants.from: run escaping func(send func(e E))) fails Stopped
mutants.to: run func(send func(e E))) fails Stopped
mutants.rule: std.ArgClauses: a Go body's parameter clause matches its review; ActorFeed runs run on a task of its own after feed returned.
